== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added 6 facts from posts on the old Players Committee forum. Posts used:
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48338#48338 Origins Report?], Kyle Krueger (30 June 2004); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48302#48302 Origins Report?], Justin Stratton (29 June 2004); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48280#48280 Origins Report?], Royce Russell (29 June 2004); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]
=== Missing data ===
* Reid Smith's Light Side deck: the report's author could not recall it; a later guess (TRM) was not used
* Kyle Krueger's Bring Him Before Me 'with Dreadnaughts' (gap list): the post does not mention Dreadnaughts
* A player posting as 'Dansbury' played a 'broken deck', lost by 33 and 32 and dropped: marginal
=== Possibly faulty data and open points ===
* The PC announcement says eight games of Swiss, but the player report gives six-round records (Hunter 6-0, Smith and Shaw 5-1, Scott and Krueger 4-2)
* Justin Stratton's own page dates his 2004 Origins entry 'July 2004'; the event was 26 June 2004
* Bill Kafer wrote on 19 January 2005 that Origins SWCCG events of the past few years had been run by [[Eric Olson]], who had stepped down ([http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229#60229 Origins?], [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015444/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229%26amp Internet Archive]); not added, since the post does not say whether it covers 2004.
* Bill Kafer's top-four report (post 48286, 29 June 2004) is cited through the page's existing pcf-3531 reference (same topic page, capture of 13 July 2004).
